regional_reset_ports.why: HBM-UCIE8 10-20 (method of the S81 SerDes column lp6): the die delivers one clock per region (ck_core = core PLL stream clock, ck_rck = the far die's forwarded pma_rck) and that region's reset beside it (released on the same edge by its landed die reset distribution), landed 2 stages on the region clock (synchroniser on the forwarded clock). No reset root, no cross-region reset path.

note: HBM-UCIE8 10-20 (DRIVE-HBM decision: HBM owns ot_pdie_ucie; the S81 MU die has 0 instances): landed UCIe column for the HBM GEN2e4 die slot host_N. Two regions: core (core PLL clk: tx face reg, live flag, PMA TX, rate-matcher read side, status) and rck (forwarded pma_rck: PMA RX, rate-matcher write side, SRAM write port). No landing: the only rck -> clk crossings are the CDC children u_rm (gray-FIFO rate matcher, elastic IDLE deletion, SRAM u_rmm dual clock) and u_sts (2-flop status sync). Bench loops the flat parent's own pma_tx back into pma_rx.
